reviewer: Coding agent: manual source-data inspection; no independent human sign-off claimed.
method: 20 deliberately diverse cleaned records compared by inspection against fresh Grants.gov fetchOpportunity data, the structured source behind the public detail page. Rolling/missing dates, zero/unknown/ranged amounts, encoded eligibility, restrictions and contact-name sponsor errors included.
scope: Source fidelity, not certification of Grants.gov accuracy or legal eligibility. Source contradictions and truncation preserved rather than resolved without evidence.
fixes_rechecked: Rolling accepted-anytime dates no longer asserted as2076 submission deadlines.
HTML decoded before removal, including nested encoding.
Old unstructured FY2012 call gg-103313 excluded from open feed.
advisory: Add source_eligibility_conflict or restriction-review flags where source boilerplate contradicts itself (PAR-25-274); no eligibility assertion should override full source restrictions.
